benchmark_gaps: SIM-001: No photosynthesis/CO2 model — growth is purely logistic with stress multipliers; no C3/C4 pathways, radiation use efficiency, or CO2 fertilization effect. Cannot model climate change scenarios or greenhouse production.
SIM-002: No yield prediction — simulation produces crop_height but no yield estimate (harvest index × biomass), grain quality, or harvestable output. Cannot connect simulation to economic decisions.
SIM-003: No root growth model — root_depth is a static parameter in water_balance.py; no dynamic root zone expansion, root water uptake by depth, or root architecture simulation.
SIM-004: No weed competition model — weed_pressure is a static scalar in SimulationState; no weed population dynamics, competition for light/water/nutrients, or weed-crop interaction algorithms.

SIM-005: No weather forecast ingestion — simulate_with_weather() accepts historical weather dicts but no forecast API integration, no stochastic weather generation, and no seasonal climate scenario drivers.
SIM-006: No multi-layer soil water model — single bucket model with uniform soil moisture; no vertical water movement, percolation between layers, or depth-dependent root uptake.
SIM-007: No van Genuchten soil water retention curves — linear stress factor between wilting point and field capacity; no soil-type-specific water retention or hydraulic conductivity curves.
SIM-008: No salinity/electrical conductivity tracking — no salt accumulation, leaching fraction, or irrigation water quality modeling. Cannot model brackish water irrigation or salinization risk.
SIM-009: No validation/calibration framework — no mechanism to validate simulation outputs against observed data or calibrate parameters. No RMSE/MAE metrics or parameter optimization.
SIM-010: No uncertainty quantification — all models are deterministic point estimates; no Monte Carlo simulation, parameter uncertainty propagation, or confidence intervals on predictions.
WB-001: No FAO-56 Kc climate adjustment — get_kc_for_stage() returns fixed values; no adjustment for wind speed, humidity, or crop height per FAO-56 Table 12/17.
WB-002: No dual Kc with proper Ke separation — dual_crop_coefficient_et() exists but Ke (soil evaporation) is not dynamically computed from soil moisture, surface wetting, or cover fraction.
WB-003: No water stress coefficient (Ks) — FAO-56 Ks from soil water depletion is not computed; water_stress_factor() is a simple linear interpolation, not the FAO-56 Ks equation.
WB-004: No soil heat flux (G) calculation — compute_et0() sets G=0.0 (acceptable for daily but not for sub-daily); no FAO-56 soil heat flux estimation from temperature or net radiation.
WB-005: No FAO-56 crop coefficient curve — Kc values are stage-based constants; no continuous Kc curve as a function of growth stage or days after planting.
WB-006: No multi-layer soil water model — single bucket with one moisture value; cannot model deep percolation, root zone depletion profiles, or layered soil textures.
WB-007: No van Genuchten soil water retention curves — linear stress factor; no soil-type-specific parameterization (sand, silt, clay fractions).
WB-008: No salinity/EC tracking — no salt balance, leaching requirement, or salinity stress factor in the water balance.
WB-009: No FAO-56 ET0 validation — compute_et0() uses simplified net radiation and no comparison against FAO-56 reference values or lysimeter data.
WB-010: No irrigation scheduling optimization — irrigation_recommendation() is rule-based; no optimization of irrigation timing/amount for yield, water use efficiency, or profit.
bottlenecks: PERF-001: Single-threaded sequential simulation — no parallel/batch simulation support for parameter sweeps, Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis, or multi-scenario comparison.
PERF-002: No time-series data persistence — simulation history is returned in-memory only; no integration with TimescaleDBStorage or any persistence layer for historical analysis.
PERF-003: No streaming output — no WebSocket or SSE push mechanism for simulation results; synchronous batch simulation only, cannot power real-time dashboards.
PERF-004: No scenario management — no mechanism to define, save, and compare multiple simulation scenarios with parameter sweeps or sensitivity analysis.
PERF-005: No API surface — no REST, gRPC, or other API to expose digital twin functionality to external systems or the dashboard.
PERF-006: No configuration management — hardcoded simulation parameters (growth_rate, optimal_temp, max_crop_height); no YAML/JSON config with per-crop parameter profiles.
PERF-007: No logging or observability hooks — module-level logger defined but never used; no metrics, tracing, or structured logging for production debugging.
PERF-008: No digital twin versioning/lineage — no tracking of which model versions, parameters, or input data produced a given simulation result.
missing_algorithms: WEED-001: Weed competition model — no weed population dynamics, competition for light/water/nutrients, or weed-crop interaction algorithms. weed_pressure is a static scalar with no biological basis.

HEAT-001: Soil heat flux calculation — no FAO-56 soil heat flux (G) estimation from temperature or net radiation. compute_et0() hardcodes G=0.0, acceptable for daily but not for sub-daily or energy balance studies.
ROOT-001: Root growth model — no dynamic root zone expansion, root water uptake by depth, or root architecture simulation. root_depth is a static parameter in WaterBalanceState.
YIELD-001: Yield prediction model — no harvest index × biomass calculation, grain quality metrics, or harvestable output estimation. total_growth is height difference only.

FORECAST-001: Weather forecast ingestion — no forecast API integration, no stochastic weather generation, and no seasonal climate scenario drivers. simulate_with_weather() accepts only historical weather dicts.
PHOTO-001: Photosynthesis model — no C3/C4 photosynthetic pathways, radiation use efficiency, or CO2 response curves. Growth is purely logistic with stress multipliers.
CALIB-001: Calibration/validation framework — no parameter optimization, no RMSE/MAE metrics against observed data, no model fidelity improvement mechanism.
UQ-001: Uncertainty quantification — no Monte Carlo simulation, no parameter uncertainty propagation, no prediction intervals on simulation results.
